title: The Four Trees: Feralas

objectives.text: Go to the edge of the Dream Bough

texts.details:
The last tree is in Feralas, in the north of that forest, near the sea. The Dream Bough. Emeriss keeps it, as the others keep theirs.

You will have wondered why our greatest have not mended this. Hear it, then. It was a druid of ours, Naralex, who first met the Nightmare face to face. He lay down in a cavern in the Barrens, meaning to bring the Dream's waters up into that dry land, and the Nightmare took him, and he could not wake. Others have lain down since and not risen as themselves.

One such is near the Dream Bough. Aldarion. He went to sleep a druid of the Circle. What woke is not him. Go to the edge of the grove, $N. Then find him, north-east of it, and do what he would have asked of you.
texts.objectives: Go to the edge of the Dream Bough in northern Feralas and kill Aldarion the Sleeper, to the north-east of it. Return to Loganaar in Nighthaven.
texts.progress: He will speak to you as a friend. He is not there to hear your answer.
texts.completion:
It is done. I knew him. Thank you for not making me go.

Four doors. You have stood before all of them, and seen what sits at each. No druid of your years has done as much since the Nightmare came.

There is one who might have ended this. Our shan'do, Malfurion Stormrage, the first of us, who learned from Cenarius himself. He walked deeper into the Dream than anyone living. And he has not come back. His spirit cannot be found. Only his body remains.

Take one of these, for the road you have walked. And come to me once more, at sixty seasons. There is something here in the Moonglade you should see.

idea: The Four Trees, level 50: the Dream Bough. From the wiki: Naralex meditated in the Wailing Caverns to connect the Dream's waters to the Barrens, was overwhelmed by the Nightmare and could not wake; Malfurion, the first mortal druid, taught by Cenarius, fell into a coma and his spirit could not be found in the Dream. Invented: Aldarion the Sleeper.
